javascript(/**
* @param {params} params

* @param {any} params.event
*/
function evaluateEvent({api, event}) {

		route: event.payload.route,
		fields: event.payload.fields,
		params: event.payload.params,
		redirect: event.payload.redirect,
		passiveNavigation: event.payload.passiveNavigation,
		title: event.payload.title,
		multiInstField: event.payload.multiInstField,
		external: event.payload.external,
		table: event.payload.table,
		sysId: event.payload.sysId,
		query: event.payload.query,
		parentTable: event.payload.parentTable
	};
})
